component.name: FilterDesk
component.summary: Passive lumped-element RF filter synthesis and analysis

description.p: FilterDesk designs, analyzes, optimizes and documents passive RF filters and matching networks for radio amateurs and RF builders.

It includes lumped-element synthesis, Touchstone import and export, VNA measurement comparison, component libraries with manufacturer Q/ESR curves, microstrip and coupled-line tools, and BOM/report generation.
